insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: Last month someone added a new field and a couple new picklist values, and the Invoca sync just stopped writing to that object.

insights.summary: Customers want to define their own QM scorecard criteria (exact disclosures, call-type-specific scoring, weighting).
insights.quote: We want to weight the criteria differently for new versus tenured agents.
